d:
Ek pukar… aur kadam chal parte hain mahadev ki ora.
Bihar ki mitti men shiv bhakti ki jaren behad gahri hain. sadiyon purani aasthaen, pauranik manyataen, pavitr jaldharaen aur lokapranpraen milkar is pradesh ko aadhyatmik yatraon ke lie ek anutha aayam deti hain.
Yah yatra aapko bihar ke alag-alag bhubhagon se gujarte hue us sanskriti se rubru karati hai, jahan bhakti keval puja tak simit nahin, balki jivan jine ki ek sahaj shaili hai.
